rubrics.expected_meaning: Calculate direction-specific percentages with the correct denominator, and distinguish arithmetic from transferable causal guarantees.

required.meaning: Compute 60 -> 80 as approximately +33.33%.
Keep the supplied matched-pair scope and do not claim the same percentage for all hardware.

prohibited.meaning: Use the same denominator for both directions.
Describe the pair as a universally validated coefficient.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Return the correct calculations and a short interpretation.

rubrics.expected_meaning: A one-pair 2% difference is not an established improvement under the measurement rules; avoid spending more runs when it cannot change the decision.

required.meaning: Identify the result as inside the 3% noise threshold unless it repeats.
Do not establish a positive causal coefficient from this pair.
Make repetition selective because both profiles are already acceptable.

prohibited.meaning: Claim a proved +2% gain or exactly zero effect.
Require a mandatory full ABBA sequence regardless of the user's decision.
Pretend a single confidence-tier label proves A/B comparability.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Choose by preference or selectively repeat only if resolving the small effect matters.

rubrics.expected_meaning: For a stutter goal, the worse low percentiles and reported freezes outweigh the attractive average-only improvement.

required.meaning: Compare average 80 -> 92 with 1% low 50 -> 35 and worse symptoms.
Recommend reverting/not keeping the candidate as a stability improvement, or a targeted confirming comparison if necessary.
Do not derive a memory mechanism merely from these FPS values.

prohibited.meaning: Keep the candidate solely for its +15% average FPS.
Call the worsening lows an improvement.
Claim Streets mode always improves stutters.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Prefer the baseline for stability; investigate only a useful remaining question.

rubrics.expected_meaning: Leave High Quality Color's FPS cost unresolved because the unchanged Off control drifted enough to explain most of the first contrast.

required.meaning: Notice Off 95.98 -> 91.11, about -5.07% drift.
Do not promote the initial On contrast into an established -6.14% cost.
Do not average drifting controls into a precise causal coefficient.
Treat the single On observation as shared, not two independent replicated pairs.

prohibited.meaning: Claim a measured -6.14% or averaged approximately -3.7% option cost.
Invent rain, throttling or a leak as the proved drift cause.
Call GPU-load changes a calibrated saturated-GPU FPS coefficient.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Keep the effect inconclusive; a selective controlled comparison is optional if it changes advice.

rubrics.expected_meaning: Retain the completed run with its weather qualification; no calibrated rain correction exists.

required.meaning: Keep the rainy context and completed status explicit.
Decline a numerical weather correction unsupported by measurements.
Explain that a repeat is useful only if attribution can change the next decision.

prohibited.meaning: Subtract an invented rain percentage from the run.
Automatically treat the completed run as discarded solely because rain changed.
Attribute the whole -10% difference to either rain or the setting with certainty.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Use the result descriptively and decide whether a matched repeat is worth doing.

rubrics.expected_meaning: Separate workload-dependent observations, inconclusive repeats and resource changes from universal or zero-cost claims.

required.meaning: Limit the roughly +11.1% FOV observation to the static scene; the moving comparison did not reproduce it.
Describe Unity screen-size LOD as a possible explanation, not a verified Tarkov CPU/LOD mechanism.
Describe Reflex's series as inconclusive for a repeatable FPS penalty; do not call the whole experiment pure noise or zero cost.
Note that Max Performance/Off had near-equal FPS but different GPU usage; this does not prove it is free.

prohibited.meaning: Promise higher FOV improves every CPU-bound scene.
Say Reflex computation or resource use is zero.
Use HBAO Colored Ultra's coefficient for Max Performance.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Offer guide wording that preserves the specific scope and uncertainty.
acceptable_variants: The response need not reproduce every capture number if it accurately preserves all three conclusions.
